verdict.rationale: Blink Shell is a mobile terminal and coding environment, and it connects to VS Code for web, Codespaces and GitPod (blink-shell-docs-7), so a git workflow question like this is fair to ask. However, nothing in the evidence mentions a merge-conflict resolution tool, multi-file conflict handling, or any git tooling at all. The documented built-in commands are basic file utilities, plus ssh, mosh, scp and sftp.
